Manage groups

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/Access-Control](https://docs.bronto.io/Account-Management/Access-Control)
:::

```sh
bronto groups <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto groups add-members`](/reference/commands/groups/#bronto-groups-add-members) | Add users or groups to a group |
| [`bronto groups create`](/reference/commands/groups/#bronto-groups-create) | Create a group |
| [`bronto groups delete`](/reference/commands/groups/#bronto-groups-delete) | Delete a group |
| [`bronto groups get`](/reference/commands/groups/#bronto-groups-get) | Get a group by ID |
| [`bronto groups list`](/reference/commands/groups/#bronto-groups-list) | List groups |
| [`bronto groups members`](/reference/commands/groups/#bronto-groups-members) | List the members of a group |
| [`bronto groups remove-members`](/reference/commands/groups/#bronto-groups-remove-members) | Remove users or groups from a group |
| [`bronto groups update`](/reference/commands/groups/#bronto-groups-update) | Update a group |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto groups add-members

Add users or groups to a group

```sh
bronto groups add-members <group> [--users <id|email,...>] [--groups <id|name,...>] [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--groups` |  | strings |  | groups to add, by id or name (comma-separated or repeated) |
| `--users` |  | strings |  | users to add, by id or email (comma-separated or repeated) |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto groups add-members oncall --users alice@example.com,bob@example.com
bronto groups add-members oncall --groups sre
```

## bronto groups create

Create a group

```sh
bronto groups create [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | key=value pair for the request body (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | request body from file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto groups create -f name=x -f limit=10
bronto groups create --input body.json
```
